currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. The older aerial supplies roof arrangement;2025 street view is tree-obscured. No bespoke surveys or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected2025 street exterior: cream walls/white classical columns and trim, tall rectangular glazed windows, shallow temple pediments, dark gray-brown small dome, white clock stage and very tall warm-brown metal needle spire with gold finial/cross. Trees obscure central dome and portions of roofs/repair areas. This picture does not establish complete repair or interior condition.

Inspected older2021 aerial for exterior arrangement: west tiered bell tower/clock/bulb and tall needle, four-column open western pediment porch, large eastern rounded dome on white arched-window drum, two smaller domes flanking the western cross range, dark low nave/cross roofs, white pilasters and side temple fronts. Separate small southeast pavilion is excluded. Older roof coverage/ornament is an approximation where the2025 street view is tree-obscured; no claim of unchanged full current restoration.
